name: Chinese Broccoli (Gai Lan)
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated for SIBO patients as it's low FODMAP and easy to digest when cooked. Steaming or stir-frying may be gentler than raw consumption.
preparationTips: Trim and discard thick stem ends, but tender stems are edible
Blanch briefly in boiling water for 2-3 minutes to reduce bitterness
Stir-fry with garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic
Cook until bright green and tender-crisp for best digestibility
